prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1274; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headaches radiating from the base of the skull. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of this type of crash. Care consisted of 19 visits including manual therapy, active range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching instructions. The course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms eased and the patient reported gradual improvement. Nearly all of the documented findings rest on the patient's own description of pain and limitation; cervical imaging and standard orthopedic and neurological examination tests were within normal limits. The patient reported a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing care. Two similar charges entered on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is favorable with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
